Head geometry for the hero portrait was generated with Tencent Hunyuan3D-2
(model hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mv-turbo, multi-view mode) from four portrait
references supplied by Alexander Imanuel Widjanarko. The generated mesh was
cleaned, decimated, UV-unwrapped and textured locally; the texture is projected
from Alex's own portrait references. Tencent claims no rights in generated
outputs.
